roles.operator: Owns design decisions, approves scope, and performs the final human canvas review.
roles.planner: Creates work items, assigns risk before execution, and defines oversight and stop conditions.
roles.executor: Reads evidence, mutates only the approved scope, validates, and reports. It cannot lower its own risk class.
roles.validator: Runs deterministic gates and reports failures; it has no design authority.
roles.adviser: May review plans or evidence read-only; recommendations do not alter authority.

risk.low: Pattern-following, local, reversible, no shared-master API change and no unresolved design decision.
risk.medium: Touches a reusable local master, multiple live instances, or a known convention with bounded impact.
risk.high: Touches shared shell/library APIs, tokens, published behavior, broad migrations, or an unresolved design decision.

low: operator comparison review after the item
medium: operator review before the next item

provenance.policy: Optional and informational. Identity never substitutes for evidence or validation.
